title: Pig Horoscope 2027: What the Fire Goat Year Means for the Pig
seo_title: Pig Horoscope 2027: Chinese Zodiac Forecast for the Year of the Goat
description: How the Pig is traditionally read in 2027, the Fire Goat year: the Pig's relationship with the Goat, your element by birth year, love and work, the months to watch, and lucky colors and numbers.
lead: Good news for the Pig: 2027, the Fire Goat year, is traditionally one of its friendlier years, because the Pig and the Goat share a triangle. Here is how the Pig is read in 2027, what your birth element adds, and the months to watch.
card_text: The Pig in the 2027 Fire Goat year: love, work, your element by birth year and the months to watch.

sections.h2: The Pig and the Goat year
paras: The Rabbit, the Goat and the Pig form one of the zodiac's four triangles of signs that traditionally get on well. A year ruled by your triangle partner is read as supportive, with more help from others and fewer obstacles.
A warm, sociable Goat year suits the Pig's generous nature. The watch-out is over-trusting or over-spending: enjoy the good company, and keep an eye on the budget.
after: 2027 is a Ding-wei year, according to the Hong Kong Observatory: Ding is a Fire stem and Wei is the Goat, so it is the year of the Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027 to 25 January 2028. These are cultural readings, not forecasts: no evidence shows a year's animal decides anyone's luck. Use them as a prompt to think about your own plans.

Born in January or early February? The zodiac year starts at Chinese New Year, so check the start date in the table; if you were born before it, you belong to the sign before the Pig. Our born in January guide and the zodiac checker explain.

sections.h2: Love and relationships for the Pig
paras: The Pig's natural matches in our guide are the Rabbit and the Goat, its triangle partners, and the Tiger. With a partner sign ruling the year, tradition reads 2027 as a warm year for love and friendship. The Snake, the Pig's opposite, is the pairing tradition marks as the hardest.

sections.h2: Work and money for the Pig
paras: Our guide links the Pig with hospitality, the food industry, teaching and healthcare, work built on care for others. A supportive year is a good time to take on more responsibility or to start something with people you trust. With money, the Pig's generosity is a strength that needs limits; a budget protects it.

Each zodiac year is also divided into twelve zodiac months. Each one starts at a solar term rather than at the new moon, beginning with the Tiger month at Spring Commences (Lichun) on 4 February 2027. sections.h2: Lucky colors, numbers and days for the Pig
paras: In our Pig guide, the Pig's lucky colors are yellow, gray, brown, its lucky numbers are 2, 5, 8, and its lucky days are Thursday and Sunday. For the full profile, read the Year of the Pig guide; for every sign in 2027, see the 2027 predictions.

faq: Is 2027 a good year for the Pig?
Yes, traditionally: the Pig shares the Goat's triangle (Rabbit, Goat and Pig), so 2027 is read as one of its friendlier years.
What is the Pig's clash month in 2027?
The Snake month, from 6 May to 5 Jun 2027. The Snake is the Pig's opposite sign, and tradition marks its month as the one to take extra care in.
What element is my Pig year?
It depends on the year you were born: 1947 is a Fire Pig; 1959 is an Earth Pig; 1971 is a Metal Pig; 1983 is a Water Pig; 1995 is a Wood Pig; 2007 is a Fire Pig; 2019 is an Earth Pig.
What are the Pig's lucky colors and numbers?
In our Pig guide: colors yellow, gray, brown; numbers 2, 5, 8; days Thursday and Sunday.
